title: 한 번만 더
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Hip-Hop track at 95 BPM in G minor. The arrangement features a heavy, distorted 808 bassline that follows the kick drum pattern. A sharp, metallic snare hits on the backbeat, layered with crisp hi-hat rolls in sixteenth and thirty-second note triplets. A dark, minor-key piano loop provides the melodic hook, consisting of staccato chords. Male vocals alternate between rhythmic, percussive rapping and melodic, belted singing in the chorus. Occasional orchestral string stabs and cinematic percussion hits emphasize the transitions. The production uses aggressive compression and a dry vocal mix with short slapback delays on the rap verses.
